title: Physical protection of transmission paths and output needs verification
remediation: The sponsor network facilities lead and information custodian identify protected transmission and distribution lines and devices that can display or print in-scope information. Verify access controls on each route type and sample physical controls for output handling by authorized users. Document cases without local output for sponsor tailoring review.

milestones.title: Collect a controlled route and output inventory, approved safeguards and a representative inspection or output access exercise
